en: Changed background Bash and PowerShell commands to stop after a time limit (their `timeout` with `run_in_background`, default 30 min, max 2 h); Claude is notified when one is stopped
zh: 变更后台 Bash 和 PowerShell 命令，使其在达到时限后停止（即配合 `run_in_background` 使用的 `timeout`，默认 30 分钟，最长 2 小时）；命令被停止时会通知 Claude
